about.title: Settings

input.rumbleTestOk: Vibration works (you should have felt it for half a second)
input.rumbleTestNone: This device cannot vibrate (the browser does not see a motor)
input.rumbleHint: The "Test vibration" button runs the motor for half a second. If the list only shows the built-in Steam Deck controls without any word about rumble, the browser cannot see their motor: start Greenlight from Steam (Add a Non-Steam Game) in Game Mode, so that Steam Input creates a virtual Xbox controller with vibration.
input.title: Input
input.vibrationStrengthHint: Lower it if the controller vibrates too much. The game decides when to vibrate and how strongly (shooting and vehicles shake a lot); this scales it. Applied when the stream starts.
input.legacyWarning: Using the Mouse & Keyboard driver together with the Gamepad keyboard mappings will cause conflicts
input.altMenu: Alt key opens the menu bar
input.altMenuHint: For desktop use. Off by default, so Alt does not open the File / Edit / View menu while playing. The shortcuts of that menu (Ctrl+R, F11) keep working.
input.kbmEmulation: Keyboard and mouse as a gamepad
input.kbmEmulationDescription: W A S D = left stick, mouse = right stick (click the picture to capture the mouse, Esc releases it), left / right mouse button = RT / LT, Space = A, Backspace = B, R = X, F = Y, Q / E = LB / RB, Shift = L3, C = R3, Tab = View, M = Menu, N = Xbox button, arrow keys = d-pad, I J K L = right stick. Takes the place of the key mappings below.
input.mouseSensitivityHint: Lower it if the mouse moves too fast. Applies to the mouse of the Mouse & Keyboard mode and is used when the stream starts.
input.enableLegacyDescription: (Disabling this feature will disable the keyboard to gamepad mapping and only allows controls from the gamepad.)
input.gamepadNavigationDescription: (Use the d-pad / left stick, A, B and LB / RB to control the Greenlight menus.)
input.controllerDetectedDescription: If you have a controller connected but it is not showing up, try to press a button on the controller to detect it.

streaming.title: Streaming Settings
streaming.description: xHome and xCloud do not support more than 20mbps by default. This setting does not override this limit.
streaming.remotePlayDescription: Port on your public IP that your router forwards to the console. The console itself always listens on 9002, so with two consoles you can forward e.g. external 9002 to console 1 and external 9001 to port 9002 of console 2.
streaming.remotePortConsolesDescription: Port per console (leave empty to use the default port):

videoAudio.title: Video
videoAudio.fullscreenAuto: Auto (in the Steam Deck game mode)
videoAudio.fullscreenDescription: In fullscreen the picture fills the whole screen, the built-in one or a docked one of another size (1920x1080 for example). The setting "game resolution" of Steam only sets the size of the picture the Deck draws; a window that is not fullscreen keeps its own size.
videoAudio.forceLowResDescription: (This option is useful on the Steam Deck and enables the application to render in a low resolution so FSR can be enabled.)

myConsoles.noConsoles: No consoles found on your account. If you do have an Xbox console then make sure that remote playing is enabled and that the console is visible in the official Xbox App.
myConsoles.subtitle: Pick a console to start playing

gamepad.streamMenuHint: Hold LB + RB + View + Menu for the Greenlight menu
gamepad.streamMenuOpenHint: Greenlight menu: d-pad / stick to move, A to select, B (or hold LB + RB + View + Menu) to close

streamWindow.gettingStreamReadyMessage: We are getting your stream ready...
streamWindow.kbmHintClick: Click the picture to capture the mouse (Esc releases it)
streamWindow.kbmHintLocked: Mouse captured. Press Esc to release it
streamWindow.itsTakingALittleLonger: It's taking a little longer.. Your stream may start soon.

translator.title: Screen translator
translator.description: Reads the text on the stream (subtitles, messages, menus, descriptions) and shows a translation on top of it. The adaptive mode finds the text on the whole screen by itself; below you can also place up to 3 windows of your own. It does not need any key.
translator.sourceHint: Text in other languages than English is downloaded once (a few MB) and then works offline.
translator.noRoom: No free place for another window
translator.editHintMulti: X: next window  |  Y: new window  |  View: remove this window
translator.typeHint: Tasks: for text that stays on screen and sways with the camera. It is not hidden while the camera moves, and a different reading must be seen twice before it replaces the shown translation.
translator.windowToggleTitle: Turn translation window {{n}} on or off
translator.regionDescription: Place the windows over the text you want to translate: for example one on the subtitles and another on the current quest. You can have up to 3 windows and they cannot overlap. You can also move them while playing with the "Area" button in the stream menu.
translator.previewText: Find the key and open the door to the north.
translator.note: The same text is never translated twice: the window only updates when the text on the screen really changes, and a moving background is ignored. Translation uses a free online service, so an internet connection is required.
translator.btnTitle: Turn the screen translator on or off
translator.btnAutoTitle: Adaptive mode: finds the text on the whole screen by itself (subtitles, messages, notes)
translator.btnMoreTitle: Manual setup: windows, log, area, translation mode
translator.btnScreenTitle: Whole screen: translate all the text on the screen as one window (handy in the menus and settings of the game)
translator.debugMenu: Menu: the whole screen is read (lines: {{count}})
translator.debugMenuCheck: Looks like a menu: checking whether the whole screen has text
translator.debugNormal: Usual mode: the windows look for text
translator.engineLabel: New engine: elements of the interface (experimental)
translator.engineHint: Instead of windows and the menu mode the translator keeps track of the elements of the interface (tabs, buttons, lines, subtitles): each one is read once, does not blink, and is read again only when it changes. Turn it off to get the usual adaptive mode back.
translator.coverLabel: Paint over the original under the translation
translator.coverHint: A solid plate of the colour of the interface is drawn over the whole area of the original text, so that it does not show through. Turn it off if the plate spoils the look.
translator.advancedHint: Rare switches: usually not needed, the adaptive mode decides everything by itself.
translator.panelsHint: When text lies on a panel (an item description, a message, a task list), the window is the size of the whole panel and the translation wraps inside it. Turn it off if windows got too big: the old behaviour (a window by the frame of the text) returns.
translator.profileLabel: Remember where the text of a game is
translator.profileHint: Places where translating has worked more than once are remembered for this console or game and trusted at once on the next run (subtitles, the corner with messages, the description panel). Only the coordinates of the places are kept, no text.
translator.fullscreenLabel: Always read the whole screen as one window
translator.fullscreenHint: Usually not needed: the adaptive mode reads the whole screen as one window by itself when it sees a menu (many lines). Turn it on if it does not recognise the menu of some game. Your windows 1-3 work then too.
translator.menuAutoHint: When the screen has a lot of lines of text (a menu, settings, an inventory), the whole screen is read as one window instead of separate windows. Close the menu and the usual mode returns.
translator.btnLogTitle: Dialogue log: the last lines of the conversation, so you do not lose the thread
translator.logEmpty: The last lines of the conversation will appear here
translator.autoHint: The translator looks for text on the whole screen by itself: subtitles, messages, achievements, notes, and translates it. Up to 3 places at a time; the windows you placed by hand come first. False alarms are dropped automatically.
translator.autoDebugLabel: Show what the adaptive mode sees
translator.autoDebugHint: Draws frames: blue dashed - text found, yellow - being read, green - translated, red - no text there. Useful for tuning.
translator.btnModeTitle: How to translate: smart (local + online), local only or online. Local needs a downloaded model (Settings, Translator)
translator.localEngineAuto: Auto (the ones on the device, else Firefox)
translator.localEngineFirefox: Firefox: newer, over 100 language pairs (Polish, Turkish too)
translator.localEngineBergamot: Bergamot: from the project, 20 language pairs
translator.localEngineHint: Two sets of small models for the same engine. If one quality does not suit you, try the other set and download its model.
translator.localDescription: Small translation models (the same kind as in the Firefox translator) run right on the device: a translation takes a few milliseconds, needs no internet and has no limits, and the text goes nowhere. The quality is a little below Google, so by default they work together: the local translation appears at once and the better online one replaces it as soon as it arrives.
translator.localModeSmart: Smart: instant draft + better online translation
translator.localModeLocal: Local only (the text never leaves the device)
translator.localModeBackup: Online, local only when online does not work
translator.localModeHint_smart: Both are asked at once. If the online one answers within a quarter of a second it is used; otherwise the local one is shown at once and replaced by the better one later.
translator.localModeHint_local: Fastest, and works without internet. The online services are only used for languages the local translator cannot do.
translator.localModeHint_backup: As before, but when there is no internet or the limit is used up, the local translator takes over.
translator.localModeHint_off: The local translator is not used.
translator.localNoModel: there is no local model for this language pair (online is used).
translator.localInstalled: the model is on the device.
translator.localNotInstalled: the model is not downloaded (about {{size}} MB).
translator.localPivot: This pair goes through English: two models are needed.
translator.localPrivacy: The models are downloaded once from the public storage of the Bergamot project (Mozilla) and kept in the cache of the app; after that the local translation needs no internet.
translator.btnAreaTitle: Move and resize the translation window
translator.editHint: Drag the window to move it, drag the corner to resize it
translator.editHintPad: Left stick: move  |  Right stick: width / height  |  LT slow, RT fast  |  A: done
translator.padEditActive: Left stick / d-pad: move  |  Right stick: width and height  |  LT: slow, RT: fast  |  A or B: done
translator.padShortcuts: While playing: hold LB + RB + Y to turn the translator on or off, hold LB + RB + X to move its window. Every line of text is translated on its own and placed over the original; numbers that only change (counters, timers) do not need a new translation.
